name: Long silent work stays visible
prose: a long stretch of reasoning never looks like a frozen window, and never goes on unannounced. The live reasoning block's summary counts time and size ("reasoning · 8m12s · ~12k tokens") and the now-line's timer reads in minutes, on the desktop and in the terminal; and once the model has reasoned at length through tool rounds without a word to the user, its next request asks for one sentence about what it is doing — once per silent stretch.
invariant: Long silent work shows that it is going on: the live reasoning block counts its time and size, and after a long stretch of reasoning with no word to the user the next request asks the model for one sentence, once per stretch.
